HOW TO PLAY

Controls:

  • W / Arrow Up: Accelerate
  • S / Arrow Down: Brake / Reverse
  • A / Arrow Left: Steer Left
  • D / Arrow Right: Steer Right
  • F: Fire Energy Laser (Combat System)
  • SPACE: Handbrake / Initiate Drift
  • R: Recover car to last checkpoint
  • ESC: Pause / Resume

Data Structures & Algorithms in Action:

  1. Graph + Dijkstra: Track checkpoints form a weighted graph. AI cars compute optimal paths and navigate shortcuts.
  2. MinHeap: Priority queue used by Dijkstra to extract nearest checkpoints in O(log n).
  3. FIFO Queue: Circular buffer controlling starting grid order and racer release.
  4. Merge Sort: Divide-and-conquer algorithm ranking racers by laps and circuit progress.
  5. Object Pool: High-performance O(1) recycling array pool managing 3D combat energy projectiles without memory leaks.
